notes.title: We Haven't Abandoned You - Development Update
notes.content:
Hi, Steam!
I just wanted to let you all know that I appreciate your patience so much, and I'm still working on getting Surrounded: Rebuild ready for launch. This last year has been packed with a lot of work, and though I've tried to keep the Discord as up to date as possible, I figured it was time for a Steam post. This will have some new information, but also info that’s been previously accessible in the Discord.



First off, we’re still aiming to release this year. I'm a one-man team and the only one working on it, so it still does take some time, but progress is steady.


What's new in the rebuild compared to the old Surrounded?Well, a lot. Such as:
For the OGs (Day & Night)

If you’ve been following Surrounded since its early TikTok days in 2020–2021, you know we’ve always planned to include a dynamic day-and-night cycle as a core feature. That feature is finally returning! Surrounded will now have a fully integrated day-and-night cycle that drastically affects gameplay depending on the time of day.

Way Better Visuals

Surrounded now utilizes Unreal Engine 5’s Lumen and Nanite systems, delivering outstanding visual quality. Lumen’s advanced lighting significantly enhances the atmosphere, creating a more immersive and realistic experience.

Protecting Yourself

In the Surrounded rebuild, you protect yourself not with weapons, but through strategic gameplay. Find something lying around? Throw it! Old cans, rocks, branches, use whatever you need to escape tricky situations. You’ll also be able to lock doors, barricade yourself inside rooms, or even block access to ladders leading to attics. Co-op players will be able to hold doors shut if there’s ever something on the other side trying to break in.

Puzzles

The puzzles in Surrounded are vastly different from what you might expect, they aren't randomized in the typical way. Our puzzles are primarily story-driven, meaning you won’t necessarily need specific items to advance. Instead, you’ll progress by learning what to do and when to do it through exploration and gameplay.

Map Progression

Progression throughout the chapter is vastly different from what you’re used to. The map is divided into zones, separated by gates that serve as checkpoints. Each zone introduces new monsters, puzzles, mechanics, environments, and lore to uncover.

Reworked Creatures

The monster designs previously felt unfair and lifeless. This has completely changed in the rebuild, ensuring every creature now feels fair and balanced. Most of them have received texture updates, rescaling, and improved animations. We’ve also added some incredible new, hand-crafted creatures that we can’t wait to show you all.


Personal Note
Thank you so much for reading, and I hope you’re just as excited as I am to share what I’ve been working on. Surrounded was my childhood dream game when I was 14, and I started development of it when I was 16 with no prior experience, which led to it being a mess on release, there’s no denying that. I was uneducated, unaware, and way too young to take on that big of a game, especially with the game being in "development hell," switching engines, switching routes throughout development, and never having a clear vision.

Years later, I’m a lot older, with industry experience and a properly structured workflow, which really reflects on the final result of the game.

I hope you enjoy these new, never-before-seen & discord-exclusive teasers of the rebuild. A trailer is also in the works!

notes.title: V0.8.9 | Voice Chat Update
notes.content:
This update aims to tackle the proximity voicechat of Surrounded.
Where voicechat would previously clip, be choppy, or not work at all, you can now expect a smooth experience both in hunted and storymode. When launching the game you'll get a popup prompting you to calibrate your microphone and select your desired input device. 

We'd love to see your funny moments using voicechat in the discord!

Other than fixing and overhauling voicechat, we have also fixed a bug where the centipede would keep chasing the player indefinitely without ever despawning. 

Full Patch Notes:

Features:

 Reworked the voice chat to increase the quality.
 Introduced a setup proximity voice chat section first time launching the game.
 You can now change the input mic in the settings menu.
 You can now calibrate your mic in the settings menu.
 You can now change voice chat volume in the settings menu.


Improvements:

 Fixed a lot of the roads that were floating above the ground.
 Corrected the items that were floating above the ground.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the centipede would get stuck & not unborrow even when player goes out of reach.


Optimization:

 Optimized the level of details on player characters to ensure no frame drops when walking into each other.

notes.title: v0.8.6 - Optimization Update
notes.content:
V0.8.6

Before posting the patch notes, this might not seem like a lot of content. However, keep in mind we are still actively working on the rebuild of the entire game, which takes place in a new wiped project. We went back to the old Surrounded project to make these changes for the quality of life & should make the overall game more accessible to older PC’s, avoid crashes while also generally improve performance.

If you want to learn more about the rebuild, check out "Development Preview #1".

Features:

 Goodbye DirectX12, Hello DirectX11 👋 After aknowleding all the issues with DirectX12 like crashes, etc, and we didn't have to use Unreal Engine's nanite system which is only supported by DX12 anymore, we have downgraded. This should make the game available for everyone.
 New initialization system that will asynchronously load maps in the lobby. You can see who has loaded the map by their name in the lobby. Everyone needs to have the map loaded before being able to start the game.
 In world jumpscares for Hunted, there will no longer be a video played but rather something that actually happens in game.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where dropping any item in Hunted could make it go under ground if crouched.
 Fixed a bug where a Syringe on the Hunted map could spawn in a very tricky way and would almost be unreachable.
 Removed a spot in Hunted where you could go to avoid the monster.


Balancing:

 Aggressive Child has been removed. The Child will always be passive.
 Over half of the child has been removed from the map.


Optimization

 Disabled Nanite to help improve GPU performance.
 Removed unnecessary particles in Chapter 1.
 Some people might have struggled to even launch the game, this should now work better with a rewritten initialization system.
 Loading times should be significantly decreased.
 Optimized some code that would happen on every frame.
 Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.4 which should help performance.
 Done shadowing optimizations to the Hunted map and all scenes in general.
 Lighting has been optimized.
 Main Menu has been optimized.
 All lobbies has been optimized.
 Other minor changes.


These changes have significantly improved performance across the entire game but please do let us know if you are still having any issues with performance we are looking to improve the experience for all looking to enjoy Surrounded even while we are working around the clock on the rebuild!

notes.title: Development Preview #1
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

We realize how important transparency is, especially for an early access game like Surrounded. It’s been a while since our last update so we figured it would be a good time to share what we’ve been working on and what we have got planned for the next update.

First of all we would like to thank you for the patience you’ve had so far. This really means a lot to us.
Ever since launch day we have been looking through each and every review. We kept working on updating the game and fixing bugs, but always felt like something was missing. Later on we came to the conclusion that the issue did not lie in band-aid solutions, but rather in the foundation of the game.
This is why, in order to achieve the vision we have for Surrounded, we have decided to rebuild the game from the ground up. While doing this we’re taking into account all -yes all- feedback, reviews and bug reports we have received from you.

What does this rebuild mean for Surrounded?

 We are not only rebuilding the game itself, but also the design behind it. We are heavily upgrading the way Surrounded is played. You can expect a lot more than just collecting 6 fuses and running through the endgame.
 In game item shop. No, do not worry, we’re not talking about microtransactions. We’re adding an in game shop where you can buy equipment with currency that is obtainable only by playing the game. You can bring the equipment you buy with you, sell it, or store it in the storage locker for use in later runs. This also means we’re adding some items you can find in the world which you can bring back with you to the lobby to then sell,  store, or take back with you into a next run!
 Complete overhaul of the lobby system. Instead of the current static lobby system where you join and then look at your own character, you will now join the lobby with your own character and be able to walk around. You join lobbies not through a 2d menu, but through an in-world whiteboard. 
 Character customization. Instead of being assigned a random character, you will now be able to make your character your own. Customize it with different clothes etc.
 Case files. You will be able to find case files that delve deeper into the story. When found, these will then be stored in your personal account and are accessible through the laptop in the lobby. Maybe these case files will also help you progress through the game?
 Completely new map. We are completely redesigning the map, and the way you progress through the map. While keeping the open world feeling intact, we are building in a certain feeling of progression to the map itself.
 Revamped AI. The current AI is not in a very solid state. The design feels unalive and at certain times also unfair. We are completely redesigning how most of the AI work and behave in order to make them feel extremely alive, a lot more interactive and scary, and much more fair to play against. You can expect to see the new AI really integrate with the world around it.
 Deeper story. For the story diehards among us (including ourselves!) we are deepening the story. We are making sure everything in the world has meaning and has a reason to exist. Lots of questions can and will be asked. It’s up to you to find the answers.


This is not all we have planned for the next update. Please understand that above points are subject to change and still in early works.

As you might have noticed, this will be an update that is many orders of magnitude larger than any and all of our previous updates combined. This means that this update will take more time to develop than our previous update pace. We will make sure to keep you updated on development as much as possible during the process.

Again, thank you all so much for the patience, support and for playing the game! Please enjoy some screenshots of early prototypes of some of the new features mentioned earlier at the bottom of this message.
With that said, thanks for reading and we’ll see you in the next development update!

Cheers, 
Nightmare Studios.

notes.title: v0.8.0 - Replayability Update
notes.content:
V0.8.0 - Replayability Update

Disclaimer:

 This is an incredibly large update which changes up a lot of the systems, there may be bugs and issues we have not encountered ourselves and we will be fixing all of them asap over the last couple of days. Thank you for helping us out.
 The loading screen may not appear at times, however, as long as you hear the music and it's black screened it's still loading.

Features:


 New Game Mode - "Hunted" (featuring a new map, a new monster, new mechanics, and more)
 New proximity voice chat system, allowing monsters to hear you
 New pinging system for item communication (exclusive to Hunted)
 New revive system, enabling crawling while knocked down
 Updated main menu, lobby browser, and polished widgets
 Completely revamped locomotion animations
 Introduction of a new level system.
 Exploration rewards players for exploring the Hunted map, encouraging them to discover old trash cans, vehicles, and other items, which can be searched to boost the amount of EXP awarded at the end of the match..
 The child and the mother now have in world jumpscare animations, instead of playing a video.
 New main font for the game.
 Added more player characters to the game.


Updates & Enhancements:

 Monsters can now hear your microphone conversations.
 You can now view the number of players in a lobby, the player's level, and the selected game mode.
 Revamped animations for the carnivorous.
 Revamped the entire Surrounded chapter 1 map, with new foliage, newly designed terrain, lampposts next to roads to increase navigability, a new look to the post processing and fog, and so much more.
 New animations for the stamina bar.
 New interaction prompt.


Balancing:

 The Carnivorous and The Mother have been nerfed significantly.
 Removed peeking mechanic
 Nerfed the total amount of Child monsters on the map.
 Decreased the visibility range of the nametags.


Bugfixes:

 Fixed widescreen monitors playing a stretched version of the splash screen.


Optimization:

 Substantial optimization improvements. We recognize that the performance is still not where it should be, and we are working hard to release patches after this update including more performance improvements.


And a lot, lot more.

notes.title: We're listening. - Update Teaser
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

We are excited about the recent attention Surrounded has received, and we want to assure you that we are carefully reviewing all the reviews, both positive and negative, to identify areas for improvement. While we've received an overwhelming number of negative reviews lately, we understand that dissatisfied customers are more likely to leave negative feedback.

Moving forward, we are excited to unveil a teaser for our biggest update ever, which we hope will address many of the issues that new players have had with the game. To our dedicated fans, we believe you'll also love this update just as much.

In this update, we are introducing a new game mode called "Hunted," designed to enhance replayability, along with a competitive level system, collectibles, optimization, mechanic refinement, and much more. We ask for your patience as we actively work on these improvements and encourage everyone to give our game another try when it's released. We appreciate all of your constructive criticism.

[previewyoutube=yOK2Pvd3a54;full][/previewyoutube]

We have taken note of the most frequent issues that players have been experiencing, including:

 Optimization and frame drops
 Confusion regarding AI behavior
 A perceived lack of content in the world
 Buggy mechanics
Rest assured, we are actively addressing these issues, along with many others.

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,
If there's anything we've learned the past few weeks, it's that transparency is key. This blog post series will be an attempt to keep the community up to date with what we're doing behind the scenes, and include you in this journey.

First of all I would like to give all of you a massive thank you for the support, bug reports, streams and kind words you have given us since launch on behalf of the entire team.

Launch Day
As you all may know, launch day wasn't the most stable launch you could've imagined. Performance was a little wonky, people had trouble joining and hosting games, AI were stuck floating in the air and games would crash.

While most of these issues had some pretty obvious fixes, one issue did not. The matchmaking system didn't allow all people to host or join games, and only restarting the game a great number of times seemed to resolve the issue temporarily, if at all. 
As soon as we saw the first bug reports of this problem we started digging into the code. 

The Multiplayer System
To give you some context I will quickly explain how the multiplayer system works:
Unreal Engine allows for the use of plugins. The build you are all playing on right now uses a plugin called "Steam Advanced Sessions". 

This plugin allows our netcode to work with steam. Such plugins provide us with a handful of handy functions for hosting games, joining games etc.

Trying to fix the problem
When we first started looking into the problem we took a look into the code, seeing if there was anything we overlooked. After confirming this was not the case, we tried updating Unreal Engine to the latest version, also to no avail. That's when we made the decision to swap to a new plugin which makes use of entirely different netcode and has many more features.

Hoping this simple swap would fix the problem we implemented the system. On a first glance, the problem seemed to be fixed. We were able to see all lobbies, host one, and join eachother without a problem!

We rolled out a quick test version of the game to a separate channel and gathered a few testers to see if they could get in. To our surprise, no one was able to either host or join a game, except for the developers of the game.

The week following after that, we have worked with many people trying to figure this problem out. To get into the more technical side of things for those interested, this is a small part of the fixes we have tried this far:

 Tried using IpNetDriver & SteamProSockets, neither worked.
 Tried numerous different DefaultEngine.ini combinations
 Tried changing the QueryPort to 27015, 27023, 27019:27049
 Tried changing the port to 7777, 27015, 27023
 Tried enabling normal SteamSockets
 Tried doing a full rebuild
 And many more.


Closing words
Even though it may seem like we are inactive at the moment, be assured we are working our hardest on this problem every day. As soon as we get the matchmaking system functioning the way it should, the community can expect a lot of fun, exciting, and scary updates. For now the priority lies with making the game accessible to everyone, meaning the matchmaking should work the way you'd expect it to.
In the meantime, please keep sharing your funny moments, bugs, jumpscares and everything in between with us and the community. We truly love to see it!

Again thank you all so much for the patience and support, and we'll see you in the next dev update. You can join the discord here.

We have some new screenshots that we believe will please your eyes and want to invite you to join our Discord community for more updates on the game. https://discord.gg/surrounded


We apologize for not being as communicative as we should have been. We understand how important it is to keep you all updated on the progress of the game and to address any concerns you may have. We are incredibly sorry for everyone we've let down, but we are doing our best on a daily basis to keep working on this game. We are a small team, but we are getting there. We release before summer, and we are just waiting on some third party assets.

Thank you for your unwavering support and patience throughout this process. We want to assure you that we are doing everything in our power to make Surrounded worth the wait. Stay tuned for more information about Surrounded soon!

Best regards,
Nightmare Studios
